Documentation.short_help: Classify wall/inlet/outlet; port 0 = input passthrough, port 1 = inlet OPT debug geometry.
Documentation.long_help: Accepts vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection (e.g. from SHYX DataSet To Partitioned Collection). Sorts side/node pairs by side-set area (descending) for classification, emits Boundary assignment + a full options file (PV template for Single inlet, HV template for Single outlet; inlet_* filled pre-merge). Optional Merge inlets (default on, Single outlet): after per-inlet OPT stats, merges inlet side/node sets into one pair on port 0 — assignment text is post-merge. Port 0 is the (possibly merged) collection with FieldData stamps. Port 1 is drawn from those two texts: Point Label for every sideset id; AABB/normals for inlets only (OPT values, bounds restored by 1/BoundsScale). Does not write BoundaryRadialValue / BoundaryVariable arrays — use SHYX Partitioned Collection Boundary Fields for that.

IntVectorProperty.name: FlowBoundaryMode
IntVectorProperty.label: Flow Boundary Mode
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Reorders side/node pairs by side-set area (descending) before classifying. Index 0 is always wall (largest). Index 1 is the single inlet (mode 0) or single outlet (mode 1); remaining openings take the other role. The options file fills inlet_* from classified inlets (always computed before any inlet merge).

IntVectorProperty.name: MergeInletsIntoOneSideSet
IntVectorProperty.label: Merge inlets into one side set
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When enabled (default) and Flow Boundary Mode is Single outlet, append all classified inlet side/node sets into one pair on port 0 after per-inlet OPT stats are collected. Boundary assignment text (file 1) reflects the post-merge map; options file (file 2) is the full PV/HV template with pre-merge per-inlet normals/bounds/flowfactor/area. No effect in Single inlet mode (only one inlet).

IntVectorProperty.name: CustomAdapter
IntVectorProperty.label: Custom adapter
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When enabled (default), Boundary assignment keeps the header and "nodeset: ..." summary with real ENTITY_IDs, but remaps data-row sideset ids: wall→3, inlet→1, outlets→21,22,... in row order (regardless of original ENTITY_ID).

StringVectorProperty.name: BoundaryAssignmentText
StringVectorProperty.label: Boundary assignment (id/nodeset/sideset)
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: After Apply (and area-descending reorder), lists side set Exodus ENTITY_ID values: header, a "nodeset: inlet/wall/outlet ..." summary (real ids), then rows "id sidesetId". With Custom adapter on, data-row sideset ids are remapped (wall=3, inlet=1, outlets from 21). When Merge inlets is on (Single outlet), this map is post-merge (one inlet sideset id). Also stored on output FieldData as SHYXBoundaryAssignmentText. Shown via shyx_boundary_assignment_info (refreshes after dataUpdated).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: InletOptNormalScale
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Normal scale (nx/ny/nz)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Multiplier for -inlet_nx/ny/nz. Default -1 so normals point into the vessel interior.

StringVectorProperty.name: InletOptText
StringVectorProperty.label: Options file (OPT)
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: After Apply, a complete solver options file: Single inlet uses the PV template; Single outlet uses the HV template. Inlet_* lines are filled from classified inlets (always pre-merge). -num_outlet is set from the outlet count. Scales below apply only to the inlet_* values. Also stored on output FieldData as SHYXInletOptText. Shown via shyx_boundary_assignment_info (refreshes after dataUpdated).
